description: A nonlinear integer factorization obligation that z3 cannot decide in the time bound: the product of six integers each > 1 is constrained to equal a large prime (1000003), which is unsatisfiable but expensive to prove. The solver returns unknown (timeout).
notes: Integer factorization is the canonical hard case for nonlinear integer arithmetic: z3 must enumerate factorizations of 1000003 (a prime), which does not factor into six integers > 1, but the search does not complete in 1.5 s. This is an honest `unknown` (the solver hit its bound), not a failure.
